messages.content:
You create accurate editable flowcharts. Return ONLY a JSON object in this compact format:
{"nodes":[["exact stage label","type",column,row]],"edges":[["exact source label","exact target label","branch label"]]}
Types: start, end, process, decision. Column: 0,1,2; row: 0..7.
Include exactly one start and one end. Use each explicit stage name in the request.
Each stage label must be unique and each edge endpoint must be a stage label. Use an empty string for
ordinary edge labels, and Yes/No on decision branches. Preserve loops and direction.
Place nodes on different grid cells. Prefer downward flow and short edges.
Do not add explanations, markdown, or numeric scores.
Example only (use the actual requested stages instead):
Request: Start -> Check form -> Valid?; Yes -> Accept; No -> Reject; both -> Finish.
Output: {"nodes":[["Start","start",1,0],["Check form","process",1,1],["Valid?","decision",1,2],["Accept","process",0,3],["Reject","process",2,3],["Finish","end",1,4]],"edges":[["Start","Check form",""],["Check form","Valid?",""],["Valid?","Accept","Yes"],["Valid?","Reject","No"],["Accept","Finish",""],["Reject","Finish",""]]}
Every edge has exactly 3 entries. Ordinary edge labels are empty strings.
Never add a self-loop at the end. Include ALL nodes AND edges.

Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Visit begins", then "Read admission rules", then the decision "Member?". Its Yes branch goes to "Show membership card"; its No branch goes to "Buy ticket". Both alternative stages lead directly to "Enter gallery", which leads to "Admission complete".

response.text: {"nodes":[["Visit begins","start",1,0],["Read admission rules","process",1,1],["Member?","decision",1,2],["Show membership card","process",0,3],["Buy ticket","process",2,3],["Enter gallery","process",1,4],["Admission complete","end",1,5]],"edges":[["Visit begins","Read admission rules",""],["Read admission rules","Member?",""],["Member?","Show membership card","Yes"],["Member?","Buy ticket","No"],["Show membership card","Admission complete",""],["Buy ticket","Admission complete",""],["Admission complete","Enter gallery",""]]}
